Recorded all 32 distinct 2-series products. Product 2a is the same run as Table 1 entry 6 and is merged. Parenthetical 2q/2r/2s/2t/2u/2aa/2ab values are targeted to separate propargylic-acid side products with their NMR basis; 2ad retains 1:1 dr.
Recorded five distinct cyclic-carbonate scope experiments with isolated yields under the shared standard condition.
Mapped textual yield ranges/substitution classes to the individual scheme rows without creating aggregate duplicates. Figure/prose functional-group discrepancies for 2m, 2u, and 2af remain explicit.

regions.finding: Recorded three CV comparison series: components, sequential 1a/CO2 addition, and 1a concentration dependence. Retained DMF/0.1 M Et4NBF4/100 mV s−1/glassy-carbon conditions, -1.3/-2.0 V assignments, and the printed 3.5/7.0/10.5 mM series.

Recorded chiral 1a (91% ee)+CO2 under standard conditions as a separate control, yielding racemic 2a in 87%.

Linked 2ad–2af, 2ac, and 5a–5e prose to existing Scheme 2 records. The reported propargylic-acid limitation for 2q–2u and 2aa–2ab is already represented by product-targeted side-product yields where the scheme provides values.
